People: Wilkie Collins (author, Wikidata Q210740), died 1889. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Collins, Wilkie, 1824-1889") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Household words, London : Bradbury & Evans, 1850-1859, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/householdwords16dick. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 78%, 90%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Wilkie Collins, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
